 'T^q + log1p(eps)*T^r': lambda p: np.column_stack([T**3/(1+p[0]*eps), T**p[1], np.log1p(p[2]*eps)*T**p[3]]),
 'T^q + eps^p*T^r + eps^s': lambda p: np.column_stack([T**3/(1+p[0]*eps), T**p[1], eps**p[2]*T**p[3], eps**p[4]]),
 'T^q*eps^r + log(1+p eps)*T^s': lambda p: np.column_stack([T**3/(1+p[0]*eps), T**p[1]*eps**p[2], np.log1p(p[3]*eps)*T**p[4]]),
}
